method: Percentages are behavior-level estimates, not code similarity measurements. 100 means the planned behavior needs no new public capability.

candidates.source_behavior: Record a portable content inventory and verify later byte identity.
candidates.rak_existing_equivalent: inventory, freeze, verify, relative-path handling, SHA-256, and machine-readable summaries
candidates.path_coupling: low in RAK; source implementation was high
candidates.project_specific_branches: archive categories and historical custody labels

candidates.source_behavior: Seal a declared prediction payload before later comparison or interpretation.
candidates.rak_existing_equivalent: freeze seals files, but has no prediction-specific canonical record or verification contract
candidates.unique_value: Canonical, self-contained prediction declaration with mutation detection and no outcome handling.
candidates.scientific_coupling: low; content is opaque and never interpreted
candidates.path_coupling: none; references must be portable identifiers or relative paths

candidates.source_behavior: Audit custody/workspace boundaries, containment, and unsafe routing before relying on a workflow.
candidates.rak_existing_equivalent: inventory's root containment and symlink-escape protections; split-audit's metadata isolation checks
candidates.unique_value: Declared multi-workspace boundary, overlap, and shared-path audit with role labels.
candidates.path_coupling: low after replacing source absolute paths with one supplied root and relative paths
candidates.project_specific_branches: archive categories, platform flags, linked-worktree relocation, and hidden-directory behavior

candidates.source_behavior: Index custody records by declared role and category without deciding scientific correctness.
candidates.rak_existing_equivalent: claims evaluate checks evidence identifiers; deviation records carry isolation/adjudication fields
candidates.unique_value: Normalized role registry plus deterministic evidence index and role-level counts.
candidates.path_coupling: none; evidence references are relative or opaque identifiers
candidates.project_specific_branches: archive role names, category priorities, and historical authority labels

candidates.rak_existing_equivalent: stable object hashing, sorted JSON writers, deterministic ordering tests, and baseline digests

candidates.source_behavior: Describe historical authority ambiguity and failure states.
candidates.rak_existing_equivalent: gate, claims, limitations, and explicit unadjudicated statuses
candidates.unique_value: No safely separable general value was established from permitted material.

candidates.source_behavior: Record Git head, status and tag facts as archival custody metadata.
candidates.rak_existing_equivalent: no Git-specific CLI; inventory and freeze cover content facts only
candidates.unique_value: Potential future provenance aid, outside Phase 1 scope.

candidates.source_behavior: Census workspaces, produce a rename plan, block unsafe moves, and compare post-move custody facts.
candidates.rak_existing_equivalent: inventory and verification cover a single root but do not orchestrate archive movement
candidates.unique_value: Potential Phase 2, read-only census only; no move, copy, deletion, or state workflow is approved.
candidates.path_coupling: high in source; must be removed before any future implementation
candidates.project_specific_branches: platform-specific metadata, external pointers, relocation, rollback, and archive categories
